WPMS No. 3054 of 2023
Hon’ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Present Mr. Sudhir Kumar, counsel for 
the petitioner.
2. Registry has pointed out the defect in the 
present writ petition. 
3. The said defect would be decided at the 
time of hearing on admission.
4. Issue notices to the respondents through 
ordinary process, registered post 
acknowledgment due as well as through e-mail 
address and WhatsApp contact, if available.
5. Steps to be taken within a week.
6. List this matter on 13.02.2024 for 
hearing on admission.
7. Till the next date of listing, further 
proceedings of Civil Appeal No. 42 of 2021 
‘Ashok Kumar Agarwal and Another Vs. 
Smt. Nirmala Devi and Others’ pending in 
the court of 1st Additional District & 
Sessions Judge, District Udham Singh 
Nagar shall remain stayed. 
8. Stay application (IA No. 01 of 2023)
stands disposed of accordingly. 
 (Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) 
 08.11.2023
Akash
